kalams.title: Kis Ne Jahaan E Kun Ke Jalwe Dikha Diye Hain
kalams.subtitle: Kalam-e-Alahazrat — Tazmeen
stanzas: Kis ne jahaan e kun ke jalwe dikha diye hain
Soye hue muqaddar kis ne jaga diye hain
Ranj o alam ke maare sab muskura diye hain
Unki mahek ne dil ke ghunchey khila diye hain
Jis raah chal gaye hain koochey basa diye hain
Afsaana apne gham ka ja kar kise sunaayen
Ginti ki reh gayi hain sarkaar ab to saansen
Kab raigaan gayi hai dil se uthi jo aahien
Jab aa gayi hain josh e rehmat pe unki ankhen
Jalte bujha diye hain rote hansa diye hain
Garche hai ma'siyat pe israar us ka kitna
Din raat ho raha hai izhaar us ka kitna
Asiyaan ki kya haqiqat anbaar us ka kitna
Ik dil hamara kya hai aazaar us ka kitna
Tum ne to chalte phirte murde jila diye hain
Ho mubtala e gham ya waise hi ranj mein ho
Un ke ghulaam ho aur aise hi ranj mein ho
Bhejo durood un par jaise hi ranj mein ho
Un ke nisaar koi kaise hi ranj mein ho
Jab yaad aa gaye hain sab gham bhula diye hain
Jab haaziri ko ghar se zaair nikalte honge
Jazbaat e qalb e muztar ashkon mein dhalte honge
Munh maangi aas pa kar kaise machalte honge
Hum se faqeer bhi ab pheri ko uthte honge
Ab to ghani ke dar par bistar jama diye hain
Sartaaj aabidon ke hain fakhre zaahidon ke
Sultaan ke do jahaan mukhtaar mumkinon ke
Haadi woh do jahaan ke makhzan woh nematon ke
Asra mein guzre jis dam bere pe qudsiyon ke
Hone lagi salaami parcham jhuka diye hain
Quran le chala hai hum ko tumhari jaanib
Le aaye baar e asiyaan ro ro tumhari jaanib
Bakhsha gaya woh jiska rukh ho tumhari jaanib
Aane do ya dubo do ab to tumhari jaanib
Kashti tumhin pe chhodi langar utha diye hain
Lillah idhar bhi dekho pyaare sawari roko
Tera hoon ik sana go pyaare sawari roko
Mujrim ko saath le lo pyaare sawari roko
Dulha se itna keh do pyaare sawari roko
Mushkil mein hain barati purkhaar baadiye hain
Mahshar mein jab pareshan har ek abd hoga
Phir aayega woh jisko ummat dard ka hoga
Sajde mein sar ko rakh ke woh mahw e hamd hoga
Allah kya jahannam ab bhi na sard hoga
Ro ro ke Mustafa ne dariya baha diye hain
Jurm o khata pe apne parda kisi ne maanga
Daaman e Mustafa ka saaya kisi ne maanga
Jannat mein sab se ooncha rutba kisi ne maanga
Mere kareem se gar qatra kisi ne maanga
Dariya baha diye hain dur be baha diye hain
Rab ki tajalliyon ki sheesha kisi ne maanga
Un se machal machal ke jalwa kisi ne maanga
Zahra ke laadlon ka sadqa kisi ne maanga
Mere kareem se gar qatra kisi ne maanga
Dariya baha diye hain dur be baha diye hain
Moula Ali ka un se jazba kisi ne maanga
Aadaa pe apne daaim ghalba kisi ne maanga
Taskheer e do jahaan ka nuskha kisi ne maanga
Mere kareem se gar qatra kisi ne maanga
Dariya baha diye hain dur be baha diye hain
Un ke sukhan ko haq ne kitna kiya mukarram
Ash'aar par Raza ke tazmeen kiya kahein hum
Jo daagh keh gaye hain kehna Ubaid paiham
Mulk e sukhan ki shahi tum ko Raza musallam
Jis simt aa gaye ho sikke bitha diye hain
